provenance.use: Real IRSA SIA answer, deduplicated by (obs_id, detector) like search_frames. Read only when SIA and TAP both fail and no cached search exists, for searches inside this disk; flagged service='snapshot', stale=True. Frames published after queried_utc are missing.

column_notes.s3_key: key in s3://nasa-irsa-spherex/; irsa_uri = 'ibe/data/spherex/' + key; obs_id, detector, release and pipeline version are parsed from it (errante.data.s3.parse_key)
column_notes.footprint: SIA s_region polygon: ra1, dec1, ra2, dec2, ... [deg ICRS, 6 decimals], closing vertex dropped; edges are great circles
